svg.title: jitNN architecture
svg.desc: User code and integrations on top of jitnn-nn, the importers and the DJL engine; the core API (Tensor, F, Grad); the engine that records operators lazily, rewrites and compiles each step into one TornadoVM task graph and replays it; operators, kernels and vendor libraries; TornadoVM compiling to CUDA, OpenCL and Metal; and the hardware. A CPU backend runs without TornadoVM.
svg.text: Tensor, F (operators), Grad (autograd), Autocast (FP16/BF16), Linalg, Fft, SparseMatrix, CustomOp
dist: collectives and data-parallel training over NCCL · io: safetensors and state dicts
at each sync point (item(), toFloatArray(), a loss read): the steps run once, later steps replay
the reference the tests check against
JIT-compiles the Java kernels for the device: CUDA C (NVRTC), OpenCL C, Metal Shading Language
